sourceClaims.claim: The authored source layer contains 40 colors, nine spacing values, and five named radii.
The semantic layer aliases source facts and owns typography, border, opacity, and control contracts.
Default border widths and 32/40px control helpers are cross-source patterns.
There are no unresolved assumptions promoted to authored source tokens.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: source hashes validate and the authored source layer retains exactly 40 colors, nine spacing values, and five radii
evidence.structural-contract: pass: generated JSON equals authored JSON, all 11 color aliases resolve to source facts, generated CSS resolves every alias, and package exports pass clean-consumer smoke
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: focused browser assertions resolve representative source and semantic custom properties to their expected computed values
evidence.accessibility: not-applicable: token serialization defines values and aliases but no standalone accessibility behavior or policy
evidence.focused-visual: pass: exact computed-style assertions cover representative color, spacing, radius, control-size, and shadow token outcomes
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: the generated styles bundle, plain-HTML fixture, and clean-package smoke consume the published token outputs
evidence.responsive-content-stress: not-applicable: token serialization is viewport-independent; responsive behavior belongs to consuming foundation or component claims

limitations: Generated outputs are evidence and distribution artifacts, never authority.
